verdict.rationale: Intuit ships an official QuickBooks Online MCP server, confirmed by a developer-docs probe. It covers the QBO API and exposes 11 financial reports, including Balance Sheet, P&L and Cash Flow, so an external agent can pull live ledger data to reason about affordability. Intuit Intelligence also answers natural-language finance questions such as "What's driving my profit?" from real-time financials. Missing for 10: no documented or hands-on example of an affordability-style ("can we afford X?") query through the API/MCP path, and no independent corroboration of the MCP server's report quality in practice.
